newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Anhui Expressway details new JV project.
newsitem.headline: Anhui Expressway details new JV project.

text.p: Anhui Expressway Co Ltd said it has entered into a conditional joint venture agreement with parent Anhui Expressway Holding Corp to set up a new company to develop and operate the Gaohe-Jiezidun highway in eastern China.
The agreement is conditional upon shareholder approval.
The company will hold an extraordinary general meeting on June 29 to approve the joint venture agreement, Anhui Expressway said in an announcement published on Wednesday.

The new joint venture company, Anhui Gaohebu-Jiezidun Expressway Co Ltd, will be principally engaged in the development and operation of an expressway and its ancillary facilities in Anhui province running from Gaohe to Jiezidun with a total length of about 110 km, it said.

The total investment in the joint venture agreement was expected to be 1.84 billion yuan, which consisted of registered capital of 300 million yuan and would be financed by capital contributions from the joint venture partners, the announcement said.
The parent company would contribute 70 percent of the capital, or 210 million yuan, representing the total construction cost which the parent company has already spent on the highway.
The listed company would contribute 90 million yuan in cash for its 30 percent equity interest, it said.
